title: Read and write only the changed memory keys in ordinary incremental task-sync export and import
outcome: Read and write only the changed memory keys in ordinary incremental task-sync export and import
acceptance: An ordinary incremental export or import with --include-memories reads, decodes and writes only the memory keys that changed against the admitted committed basis; unchanged memory files are not read from Git or rewritten
A full memory read happens only at bootstrap or in an explicit, named rebuild; a missing or inconsistent basis refuses with a named reason instead of silently reading everything
A proportionality measurement on a fixture with at least 500 memory keys shows Git-side bytes read and decodes scaling with the changed keys, recorded on this item
